integrity: Standalone original derivation with exact moment and rational-enumeration checks; no independent audit or independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two reciprocal agents only; conditionally independent Bernoulli action sampling; fixed common coefficient strictly between zero and one. The optimized rate is for expected squared error to the random terminal binary consensus, not for almost-sure trajectorywise convergence or larger networks. Literature search not exhaustive.
title: A sharp interior rate optimum for reciprocal random-action consensus
